messages:
erin: Heads-up — started getting a customer escalation from acme-corp: ~10:12 PST we see a spike of 502s for hosted inference calls (non-streaming and streaming both). ~8-12% error rate for tenant `acme-corp` across frontdoor. Sample trace IDs: trace/0a1b2c3d, trace/0a1b2c9f. Anyone on triage?
sam: I can pickup. Any repro steps or curl samples? Are errors immediate 502 from edge or upstream 5xx?
erin: From initial reports looks like edge returns 502 with upstream reset in logs. Customer attach shows `upstream response error` from Envoy side. Repro curl they ran: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/generate``` got HTTP/2 502 after ~1.2s.
jules: Question: did we recently push any auth / heartbeat changes for the edge auth cache? I recall a keepalive tweak last week. Could be keepalive/conn-window drift causing upstream to drop active sockets.
erin: We had an auth heartbeat TTL bump in canary yesterday (auth-cache heartbeat window from 30s -> 90s). Rollout targeted frontdoor pool.
maria: Pulling envoy admin stats now from a frontdoor pod: `GET /stats?filter=upstream_rq_5xx` shows `upstream_rq_5xx: 78` in last 5m, baseline ~2. Also `cluster.auth-proxy.upstream_cx_closed: 240` spikes.
sam: grabbing logs: `kubectl logs frontdoor-112 -c envoy | grep "upstream response" | tail -n 50` shows repeated `upstream reset before response complete` for cluster auth-proxy and cluster model-backend.
eng-oncall: tagging in. Can we confirm if this is auth-proxy returning 502s or the edge translating upstream resets? If auth-proxy is timing out it might send 502s to edge.
jules: Two quick repros: 1) run long-poll streaming request and observe connection drops after ~30-60s; 2) short sync calls sometimes 502 immediately. Hypothesis: connection heartbeat mismatch between auth-proxy and frontdoor NGINX/Envoy -> idle connections closed unexpectedly.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0427-01, paging eng-oncall.
sam: Steps I'm running: (1) curl frontdoor admin `/clusters` to get per-cluster connect timeouts; (2) increase auth-proxy keepalive timeout on sidecar from 60s -> 180s in canary; (3) temporarily scale up frontdoor pool by +2 to absorb churn.

jules: Also pulling packet counters on midproxy: `envoy_stat dump | grep conn_window` shows some window update errors. Could be HTTP/2 windowing drift resulting in `RST_STREAM` and edge 502s for streaming endpoints.
maria: Customer traces show `:status 502` and upstream proto error `RST_STREAM 2` on H2. Non-streaming 502s often have `upstream connection closed` in logs with no upstream body.
sam: Mitigation applied: bumped frontdoor pod replicas from 6 -> 8 in region, rolled restart of canary nodes where auth heartbeat was applied. Also reverted auth-heartbeat TTL on two canary hosts to previous value. Monitoring now.
erin: I notified customer with temporary workaround: reduce concurrency (small batch size) while we stabilize. They acknowledged.
eng-oncall: Observability: enabling higher sampling for edge traces for `acme-corp` to 100% for 15m to capture full stacks. Also toggled per-route `stream_idle_timeout` to 0 (disabled) on a canary to see behavior.

maria: After roll restart + revert, upstream 5xx dropped from 8% -> 0.9% over 8 minutes. `upstream_cx_closed` counts dropped back near baseline.
jules: Root cause hypothesis: auth-heartbeat TTL increase created periods where frontdoor kept pooled connections open longer; combined with HTTP/2 windowing drift on specific midproxy versions -> occasional RST_STREAM/upstream resets translated to 502s at edge. Two contributing factors: (1) heartbeat change expanded reuse window so stale TCP/H2 connections persisted longer; (2) midproxy H2 window bug surfaces on longer-lived connections.

sam: Action items: 1) Rollback heartbeat TTL in prod (done), 2) Patch midproxy H2 window handling (ticket created), 3) Add health-check to detect H2 window drift on active connections, 4) Add circuit-breaker that forces conn refresh for routes if cx_closed rate spikes.

erin: Customer update: sent summary + ETA for patch (72h) + permanent mitigations. They accepted.

eng-oncall: Marking incident resolved for now, will follow up in postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427-01 status -> RESOLVED (8m after mitigation)
maria: Note for postmortem: include `kubectl` commands used, admin stat outputs, and the specific midproxy commit that regressed.

sam: Leaving next steps in ticket: link to PR for midproxy patch, schedule canary verification tomorrow.

erin: Thanks all :heart: — great triage and quick mitigation.
